reader_summary.overview: Adrian Meli is the co-CIO of Eagle Capital Management, a 36-year-old firm that manages $34 billion using a style-agnostic, long-only strategy. Adrian joined Eagle in 2008 from the hedge fund world and has helped build a team almost entirely comprised of analysts with similar DNA. Our conversation covers Adrian's early passion for finding value, path to investing, and transition from the hedge fund world to long-only at Eagle.

key_points.text: We discuss Adrian's rationale for moving towards long-only, building a team of similar-minded analysts, finding a right to win.
Along the way, we discuss overcoming the challenges of active management, the growing inefficiencies in the public markets.
